title: Simply Comfortable 1 bedroom downtown condo
description:
Experience modern luxury in this brand-new one-bedroom pullout couch downtown apartment. Immerse yourself in the heart of the city with sleek furnishings, contemporary decor, and stunning views. Ideal for both business and leisure travelers, our space offers a stylish retreat within walking distance to the best restaurants, shops, and attractions. Unwind in comfort, revel in the urban vibes, and make the most of your stay in this chic and centrally located Airbnb gem

# T2022050569

The space
This Apartment is in the HEART of downtown, literally walk to Broadway and more! This unit is both stylish and cozy. Be in the center, 2 blocks from Bridgestone, 1 block from honky-tonk bars and restaurants on Broadway. 1.5 mi to Nissan Stadium. Visit the Ryman and Johnny Cash Museum and The Country Music Hall of Fame. This unit is close to everything that you can experience. Pool. Fitness center.

Music Row

This stylish unit is a beautiful 1 BR apartment with comfortable furniture and a sky view of beautiful Nashville. It is fully decorated with a modern touch.  The bedroom has a cozy QUEEN size bed. The sofa is HUGE and can sleep up to 2 guests. Wake up to a nice warm cup of coffee or tea and enjoy your stay.

The shared amenities are maintained and monitored by the building. We are not responsible for the closure or unavailability of any of these shared amenities, which is out of our control. Should a situation occur during your stay (pool closure, etc.) we will not be able to accommodate a refund for your stay. We DO however do our best to notify guests immediately when we are made aware of any closure of amenities.

Other things to note
The building is equipped with a keypad and keyfob entry lock system. We will give guests access codes and instructions! We will send detailed instructions that breaks down the details on how the keyfob is picked up and returned, as well as how to use it.

Parking is available for your stay for a charge. Just be mindful that street parking is very limited. Ask us about rates.
